# 7445 - BCD to decimal decoder/driver with open-collector outputs

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/7445.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/7445.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 12 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![7445 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/7445.png) | ![7445 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-7445.png) | ![7445 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-7445.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A') | Output 0 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 2 | 1 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B' AND A) | Output 1 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 3 | 2 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A') | Output 2 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0010; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 4 | 3 = NOT (D' AND C' AND B AND A) | Output 3 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0011; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 5 | 4 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A') | Output 4 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0100; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 6 | 5 = NOT (D' AND C AND B' AND A) | Output 5 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0101; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 7 | 6 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A') | Output 6 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0110; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 9 | 7 = NOT (D' AND C AND B AND A) | Output 7 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 0111; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 10 | 8 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A') | Output 8 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 1000; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |
| 11 | 9 = NOT (D AND C' AND B' AND A) | Output 9 is low (on, transistor sinking) only when DCBA = 1001; inputs 10-15 leave every output high. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 80 |
| outputMaxVoltageV | 30 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | Open-collector, 30 V off-state output voltage (recommended operating conditions). Sinks up to 80 mA per output (description; VO(on) max 0.9 V at 80 mA, 0.4 V at 20 mA). Off-state leakage max 250 uA at 30 V. Lamp, relay or MOS driver. |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C, CL 15 pF, RL 100 ohm.

| From | To | Edge | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|
| A,B,C,D | any | PLH | 50 |
| A,B,C,D | any | PHL | 50 |

## Not known

- Typical propagation delays: the table gives maximum only.
- IOL is not in the recommended-operating-conditions table; 80 mA is the figure from the description and the VO(on) test condition.
- IOH as a source current does not apply (open collector); outputHighMaxCurrentMa is null.

## Notes

The datasheet gives no minimum propagation delays; the path-delay function uses 0 ns for the minimum.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. 1976, section 7 (MSI/LSI data sheets)](https://bitsavers.mirrorservice.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - 7-20, 7-21 (PDF pages 19-20); SN7445
